description: This file implements a Krisp turn analyzer for end-of-turn detection using the Krisp VIVA SDK. It defines classes for turn analysis parameters and the main turn analyzer, handling SDK initialization, session creation, audio processing, and turn state determination.

classes.name: KrispTurnParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for Krisp turn analysis, including threshold and frame duration.

classes.name: KrispVivaTurn
classes.description: Main class implementing turn analysis using Krisp VIVA SDK, managing SDK sessions, processing audio, and determining turn states.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the KrispVivaTurn object, setting up SDK, model path, and session.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Releases SDK resources when the analyzer is destroyed.

methods.name: _create_tt_session
methods.description: Creates a turn detection session with specified sample rate.

methods.name: set_sample_rate
methods.description: Sets the sample rate and recreates the turn detection session.

methods.name: append_audio
methods.description: Processes incoming audio buffer, updates turn state based on model probabilities.

methods.name: analyze_end_of_turn
methods.description: Returns the current turn state and metrics, based on last processed audio.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets internal state of the turn analyzer.
